limitations: Applies only to unshifted synchronous binary parity updates on friendship graphs with m>=2; uniform random reset is not input-dependent convergence.
scientific_integrity: The stated exact identities are proved for every integer m>=2. The code only checks a finite range. Novelty is conditional on the inspected literature and remains subject to specialized unpublished or unindexed results.
title: A seven-element parity-switching semigroup on friendship graphs
